actions: Separate old-Pod availability from new-Pod health and version verification.
analysis: A startup-failure drill demonstrates maxUnavailable=0/maxSurge=1 release protection; it does not prove that the new version works, and the old Pod still serving is not new-version provenance.
cautions: Do not claim a successful release because the old Pod stayed Ready.
excerpt: - 启动失败：新 Pod 输出 StartupError/`startup_failed`、CrashLoopBackOff，旧 Pod 保持 Ready 并返回 200；触发 DemoPodCrashLooping。这是发布保护，不是全服务中断。
rollback: Restore DEMO_STARTUP_FAIL=false, roll out a healthy new Pod, and verify endpoints and version separately.
title: 启动失败只验证滚动发布保护
